rationale: The long is only 0.11% in profit and sits below both VWAP and the 9‑EMA, indicating bearish pressure. With the market down 1% and VIXY up 9%, the odds of the price falling to the invalidation level (≈1.5 ATR) exceed the odds of reaching the take‑profit (≈3.6 ATR). Closing locks the small gain and avoids further downside risk.
